patch.summary:
Choose Dext only if your buying job matches “Bookkeeping and receipt automation for accountants and small businesses — affiliate partne” rather than Navan's shape. Choose Navan only if your buying job matches “Corporate travel and expense management — affiliate partner in accounting & finance.” rather than Dext's shape.
